section: Iterate — change: optional Capability column in the FR table
title: Optional Capability column after Area; every FR-table reader tolerant
context: Intent pyramid U1a: the FR table needs a stored Capability column (U0 ADR) before values (U2b) and a gate (U1b) arrive; fixed-shape readers would break on it.
decision: Define the with-Capability shape in fr_table_shape (after Area); the layer writer accepts both canonical headers; the label-hit scan reads bookkeeping columns by header; the digest ignores Capability. Producers still emit seven columns.
consequences: Readers take the table with and without the column; webui fold-map.ts and leadwright spec-ac-parsing.ts are positional and must be fixed before U2b fills the column.
rationale: Header-driven reading removes position dependence for the next optional column too; Capability is AI-owned bookkeeping, not normative text.
rejected: Column last (keeps external positional readers working but departs from the U0 ADR); derive from the id group; store outside the table.
